# commitment beneficiary

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:commitmentBeneficiary`](gmeow-commitmentBeneficiary.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/commitmentBeneficiary>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/teleology`](../../slices/teleology.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An agent toward whom the commitment is made. NOT functional: a commitment may be made toward several beneficiaries at once. Must be distinct from the committed agent (SHACL); a resolution one makes purely to oneself is an [`Intention`](../classes/gmeow-Intention.md), not a [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:commitmentBeneficiary`](gmeow-commitmentBeneficiary.md) from [`gmeow:Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

# --- The commitment: a relator binding the committed agent to a beneficiary,
#     aimed at the same goal — distinct from merely intending; a promise made TO
#     someone (a Commitment is an intentional moment, so it too aims at a goal).
#     The beneficiary must be an Agent — here the employer who sponsored the
#     degree (a gmeow:Group is a gufo:Collection, not an Agent).
ex:commitment a gmeow:Commitment ;
    gmeow:committedAgent        ex:dana ;
    gmeow:commitmentBeneficiary ex:employer ;
    gmeow:intentionGoal         ex:degreeGoal .

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name an agent toward whom a [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md) is made — the recipient side of the social bond, repeated when several beneficiaries share one commitment.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the committing agent (use [`gmeow:committedAgent`](gmeow-committedAgent.md)) and avoid naming the committed agent here — beneficiary and committed agent must be distinct (SHACL); a resolution made purely to oneself is an [`Intention`](../classes/gmeow-Intention.md), not a [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md).

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) beneficiaries to the [`Commitment`](../classes/gmeow-Commitment.md); keep them disjoint from [`gmeow:committedAgent`](gmeow-committedAgent.md) and let the period ride the relator.

- ex:slaPromise [`gmeow:commitmentBeneficiary`](gmeow-commitmentBeneficiary.md) ex:client.
